annotation.title_clean: The cyber-physical infrastructure: empowering innovation, people, robots and smart machines to enhance prosperity, resilience, sustainability and security
annotation.title_en: The cyber-physical infrastructure: empowering innovation, people, robots and smart machines to enhance prosperity, resilience, sustainability and security
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Department for Science, Innovation and Technology; Department for Business, Energy & Industrial Strategy (Robotics Growth Partnership)
annotation.summary_en: GOV.UK publication page for the Robotics Growth Partnership's independent 2022 vision of a cyber-physical infrastructure (testbeds, living labs, digital twins, simulation) to accelerate smart robotics innovation across agriculture, manufacturing, healthcare and logistics, with a ministerial response.
key_provisions_or_claims: Proposes a connected cyber-physical infrastructure for faster, cheaper, lower-risk robotics innovation
Includes testbeds, living labs, digital twins and simulation tools
Targets sectors such as agriculture, manufacturing, healthcare and logistics
Robotics Growth Partnership is an independent advisory body set up in 2019
Minister's response welcomes the report and sets out next steps
